pm_rationale: Adobe offers best risk/reward in IT sector with strong momentum (+25% month) meeting attractive relative valuation (cheapest vs. peers) and analyst upside (+6.4% to target). Quality SaaS franchise temporarily mispriced.
portfolio_thesis: Consensus views Adobe as mature SaaS recovering from AI disruption fears. My view: AI integration actually enhances Adobe's moat by making creative workflows more efficient, driving higher subscription values and retention. Recent momentum reflects institutional recognition of this dynamic, but valuation has not caught up to quality peers.
